excludedTargets.reason: Explicit thread selection; not included in timing or flame widths.

method: Actual CDP samples[i] weighted by timeDeltas[i]/1000 milliseconds; self groups identical runtime frames, inclusive rankings count each identical frame at most once per sample to avoid recursive double counting. SVG preserves the sampled calling stack.
limitations: Every profile requires actual extended.cpuProfiling=true or sharp report.profile=true with a recorded trace boundary; all timing is profiler-instrumented, not a clean latency benchmark.

Targets are labeled only by their actual recorded renderer/TargetInfo metadata. A worker is named render-worker only when its recorded worker URL names that module; other workers retain their type/index. Missing render-worker coverage is explicit.
Only recorded target isolates are sampled; unsampled preparation/native/GPU processes are outside this record.
Idle is not CPU computation and is not evidence of GPU-only waiting; (program) is unattributed, not classified as GPU time.
WASM indexes remain literal; no Rust symbols are inferred or imported.
Main and worker start/stop windows differ and must not be added together as wall latency.
The complete CDP profile is analyzed; the epoch-clock native trace boundary is retained without inventing a conversion to the monotonic CDP sample clock.
SVG width normalizes active samples only; idle/program weights remain explicit in the summary. This is a flamegraph, not a timeline.
Source-map locations describe the hash-matched captured build, not necessarily subsequent checkout edits.

profilingProvenance.scope: Profiler start precedes the native motion trace and stop follows it. Samples cover the whole recorded profile, including the surrounding profiler window. Epoch trace timestamps are not guessed into the CDP monotonic sample clock. Not a clean latency benchmark.
